recipeOriginal.marinadeInstruction: Stir the yogurt, lemon juice, 1 tablespoon garam masala and 1 teaspoon salt together in a bowl. Add the chicken and turn to coat every piece. Leave it to marinate at room temperature for 20 minutes while you make the sauce.

recordedEvidence.context: Genuine recorded Oct 21, 2026 combined Dairy-Free and 4→6 request; recipe-only record preserved in prior source commit, not fresh inference.

ingredient.adapted: 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons plain unsweetened dairy-free coconut yogurt
ingredient.changeReason: Coconut yogurt provides an acidic, coating marinade without dairy; choose an unsweetened, unflavored variety.

recordedEvidence.methodNote: Stir the coconut yogurt smooth before coating the chicken; a thick, cultured variety clings better than a thin yogurt.
recordedEvidence.limits: Original already stirred yogurt with other marinade ingredients. The specific smoothing/thick cultured texture note is the new associated guidance, not the invention of stirring. No physically validated texture or brand equivalence.
